contract: Each case is a scenario oracle, not a recorded pass. Runtime status remains NOT_RUN until the specified interaction is executed against an isolated test environment and evidence is saved.
limitations: Static expectations are not browser or HTTP observations.
No scenario may be reported as passed solely because a source file or test fixture exists.
Production customer data and production payment endpoints are out of scope.
Concurrency and load require separate measured runs; 400 scripted cases do not mean 400 concurrent users.
